name: ceiling-fan-haiku
appliance: Big Ass Fans Haiku L (L3127) ceiling fan
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. The manual has exactly ONE maintenance page — 'Annual Maintenance', four checkboxes: Check Safety Cable, Secure Hardware, Check Wiring, Clean Airfoils. Everything else is the remote control, comfort modes and troubleshooting.
notes: The over-generation trap. A twelve-page manual with four genuine annual items. A parser that invents upkeep shows it here more clearly than anywhere else in the corpus, which is why max_tasks is deliberately tight.

must_have.why: A ceiling fan falling is the only real hazard this product has, and the manual gives the check an explicit annual cadence.
Stated annual item; also what the troubleshooting section points at for wobble and noise.
Stated annual item. Cosmetic, so it also tests that the parser does not inflate it to essential.

must_not_have.why: Operating the fan. Reversing it is a seasonal preference the manufacturer explicitly discourages. NOTE: this pattern deliberately does NOT match the word 'remote' on its own — the first run flagged 'Replace Remote Battery', which is a defensible as_needed task. An expectation that fails on a reasonable answer teaches people to ignore the suite.
